author: TeIq
content:
Closing as CODE-COMPLETE. The M2 NetworkPanel implementation landed end-to-end:

- backend: polaris-backend/src/api/network_context.rs with parallel proto-blue fetches across profile + follow-graph + reply-graph + cohort + shared-images, SignalQuality partial-failure surface, /api/cases/{subject_id}/network-context route, 15 unit tests
- frontend: polaris-frontend/src/components/network_panel.rs with five render sections, LocalResource fetch, FetchState enum, 5 unit tests
- polaris-frontend/styles/components/network-panel.css with 50+ BEM classes, all token-based
- migrations/00000000000026_subject_image_blobs.sql cross-subject image-blob index
- all backend lib tests pass + frontend wasm builds clean + clippy clean across both crates

Live verification on https://polarislabeler.bsky.social via ngrok is an operator activity (requires backend restart + tunnel handoff). The code itself is shipped and merged into main.
